mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS LV , p.PJ_CMMNT_ID , p.PJ_ID , p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID , p.CMMNT_CNTNT , p.CRTD_DT , p.LST_MOD_DT , p.IS_DLT , p.DLT_DT , p.ATHR_ID , m.MBR_NM , ARRAY[LPAD((9999999999 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.CRTD_DT)::bigint)::text, 11, '0')] AS sort_path FROM PJ_CMMNT p INNER JOIN MBR_INFO m ON p.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR WHERE p.PJ_ID = #{_parameter} AND p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID IS NULL AND p.IS_DLT = '0' UNION ALL SELECT cte.LV + 1 , p.PJ_CMMNT_ID , p.PJ_ID , p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID , p.CMMNT_CNTNT , p.CRTD_DT , p.LST_MOD_DT , p.IS_DLT , p.DLT_DT , p.ATHR_ID , m.MBR_NM , cte.sort_path || LPAD((9999999999 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.CRTD_DT)::bigint)::text, 11, '0') FROM PJ_CMMNT p INNER JOIN MBR_INFO m ON p.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR INNER JOIN cte ON p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID = cte.PJ_CMMNT_ID ) SELECT LV, PJ_CMMNT_ID, PJ_ID, PRNT_CMMNT_ID, CMMNT_CNTNT, CRTD_DT, LST_MOD_DT, IS_DLT, DLT_DT, ATHR_ID, MBR_NM FROM cte ORDER BY sort_path ASC
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT PJ_CMMNT_ID FROM PJ_CMMNT WHERE PRNT_CMMNT_ID IS NULL AND IS_DLT = '1' UNION ALL SELECT p.PJ_CMMNT_ID FROM PJ_CMMNT p INNER JOIN cte ON p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID = cte.PJ_CMMNT_ID ) UPDATE PJ_CMMNT SET DLT_DT = NOW() , IS_DLT = 1 WHERE PJ_CMMNT_ID IN (SELECT PJ_CMMNT_ID FROM cte)
UPDATE PJ_CMMNT SET DLT_DT = NOW() , IS_DLT = 1 WHERE PJ_CMMNT_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PJ_CMMNT ( PJ_CMMNT_ID , PJ_ID , PRNT_CMMNT_ID , CMMNT_CNTNT , CRTD_DT , LST_MOD_DT , IS_DLT , DLT_DT , ATHR_ID) VALUES( NEXTVAL('PJ_CMMNT_PK_SEQ') , #{pjId} , #{pjCmmntId} , #{cmmntCntnt} , NOW() , NULL , 0 , NULL , #{athrId} )
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS LV , p.PJ_CMMNT_ID , p.PJ_ID , p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID , p.CMMNT_CNTNT , p.CRTD_DT , p.LST_MOD_DT , p.IS_DLT , p.DLT_DT , p.ATHR_ID , m.MBR_NM , ARRAY[LPAD((9999999999 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.CRTD_DT)::bigint)::text, 11, '0')] AS sort_path FROM PJ_CMMNT p INNER JOIN MBR_INFO m ON p.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR WHERE p.PJ_ID = #{searchIdParam} AND p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID IS NULL AND p.IS_DLT = '0' UNION ALL SELECT cte.LV + 1 , p.PJ_CMMNT_ID , p.PJ_ID , p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID , p.CMMNT_CNTNT , p.CRTD_DT , p.LST_MOD_DT , p.IS_DLT , p.DLT_DT , p.ATHR_ID , m.MBR_NM , cte.sort_path || LPAD((9999999999 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.CRTD_DT)::bigint)::text, 11, '0') FROM PJ_CMMNT p INNER JOIN MBR_INFO m ON p.ATHR_ID = m.EMIL_ADDR INNER JOIN cte ON p.PRNT_CMMNT_ID = cte.PJ_CMMNT_ID ) SELECT LV, PJ_CMMNT_ID, PJ_ID, PRNT_CMMNT_ID, CMMNT_CNTNT, CRTD_DT, LST_MOD_DT, IS_DLT, DLT_DT, ATHR_ID, MBR_NM FROM cte ORDER BY sort_path ASC LIMIT #{exposureListSize} OFFSET #{currPageNo} * #{exposureListSize}
